title: Choose the session that fits where you are right now
description: Start with the basics, get help setting up safely, or explore how Bitcoin may fit your business.

howToChoose.title: Not sure which session is right for you?
points: If you are completely new to Bitcoin, start with the Bitcoin Intro Session.
If you already want practical guidance around wallets and safer setup, choose Wallet & Security Setup.
If you are a founder or business owner exploring Bitcoin from a company perspective, choose Bitcoin for Small Business.

services.title: Bitcoin Intro Session
services.subheadline: From zero to your first clear Bitcoin plan
description: A 60-minute session for beginners who want a practical and easy-to-understand introduction to Bitcoin.
services.outcome: You leave with a clearer understanding of Bitcoin and a practical next-step plan.
bestFor: People who want to understand Bitcoin before doing anything practical
Anyone looking for a calmer and more structured start
whatWeCover: What Bitcoin is and why it matters
How Bitcoin works at a high level
How Bitcoin differs from speculation and noise online
How to get started more safely

services.title: Wallet & Security Setup
services.subheadline: Set up your wallet the right way with guided support
description: A 90-minute guided session for people who want practical help getting started with wallets and safer Bitcoin habits.
services.outcome: You leave with a wallet setup plan, stronger security habits, and more confidence moving forward.
bestFor: People who already own some Bitcoin and want more clarity
Anyone who wants safer first steps without unnecessary complexity
whatWeCover: Wallet options and how to choose between them
Seed phrase basics and secure storage habits
Common security mistakes and how to avoid them
Safer habits for long-term Bitcoin use

services.title: Bitcoin for Small Business
services.subheadline: A practical workshop for business owners exploring Bitcoin
description: A focused session for small businesses that want a clearer understanding of how Bitcoin may be relevant in practice.
services.outcome: You leave with a better understanding of Bitcoin in a business context and clearer next steps for further evaluation.
bestFor: Businesses exploring Bitcoin as a topic, payment option, or strategic area
whatWeCover: Accepting Bitcoin and what it may involve
Questions specific to your business situation
whatYouLeaveWith: A clearer business perspective on Bitcoin
Clearer next steps for further evaluation
